text:
Roope Hintz has 15 points in 17 games, five goals in his last ten, and a three-point night against Washington. He's playing about 16 and a half minutes a night, less than he used to, and making the most of every one.

Here's the catch. He's shooting 21.9% on just 32 shots, against a talent range of roughly 11 to 16%, and Dallas has scored 3.8 more goals than expected with him on the ice. The Stars get 52% of the expected goals at five on five with him out there, decent but not dominant. Some of this pace is borrowed.

What isn't borrowed is the defense. Evolving-Hockey rated him 20th of 401 forwards last season, with opponents getting fewer chances against him than against almost anyone (99th percentile). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says 55% of his shots come off the rush, so he does his damage in transition. He's also 33rd of 515 skaters in wins added by goals. Watch the shot total: at under two a game, the goals will slow when the percentage does.
headline: Hintz is scoring at a rate he can't keep
